unique_shortest_post_capture_dag: 1. Canonical M1327 ep34 capture completes once; no retry.
2. Run M1335 with the pinned interpreter against the canonical result and obtain a fresh different-author blind PASS.
3. Freeze one measurement identity: ep34 checkpoint/config/profile, decoder-complete operator scope, fixed numerator, multi-sequence density strata, and aggregation weights.
4. Materialize and bind existing direct payload branches: C1 Conv3x3, decoder D0-D3 through M1328 plus D1 miter, and attention Q/K/gate NPZ. Bind exact weights/bias and file identities.
5. Close all remaining operators with exact payload/adapters or one frozen analytic fallback charged identically to every row; no new acceleration mechanism.

6. Run one unified address-timed simulator for B0/B1/B2/B3/C2/Ours under the exact common resource tuple; emit cycles, stalls, SRAM/DRAM transactions, fixed numerators, and per-sequence/density breakdowns.
7. Bind native physical/activity evidence and memory energy: 17 macros, DC/Formality/PT/SAIF/PTPX, SRAM access energy, and DRAM transaction energy; bind final accuracy.
8. Different-author hammer the complete bundle, publish an additive M698/M653 registry authority, then populate Table-A.
